init.title: Polling options
init.description: Both boards refresh together. Set a target to combine later windows; the card's max_rows independently limits displayed rows. At most 8 overlapping windows are fetched, without requesting tomorrow. The target is not guaranteed when services are sparse. Zero keeps the current window only. Changing this reloads only this station.
